subject.title: fix(ui): prevent previous-agent sessions appearing after agent switches

question: Should a Control UI owner approve this maintainer-labeled state-reset fix after reviewing direct after-fix agent-switch proof?
rationale: The patch changes the lifecycle boundary for asynchronously streamed UI session catalogs, and the protected label requires explicit human handling even though the proposed implementation appears focused.
